pages.text: $(bold)What is synergy?$(0) Count the $(4)non-native organs$(0) by creature source: when one genome fills enough slots, a hidden "ecosystem set" bonus activates — the reward for a pure build.$(br2)$(bold)Rules:$(0)$(li)Native organs never count$(li)Group each source, keep the $(4)largest group$(0)$(li)$(4)3+ organs$(0) = minor synergy; $(4)6+ organs$(0) = major synergy (majority of the nine slots)$(br2)To trigger a set, let that genome dominate your body — mixed builds trigger nothing.

pages.title: Ender and the empty rows
pages.text: $(bold)$(4)Ender set$(0) (escape artist)$(li)Minor: 15% chance to blink away when hit$(li)Major: 25% chance to blink away when hit$(br2)$(bold)$(4)Explosive / Boss / Dragon$(0)$(li)No synergy implemented yet — the payoff of these high-purity groups lives in organ quality and traits, not set bonuses$(br2)Tip: Aberrant and Ender effects resolve $(4)when you take a hit$(0) — higher armor (smaller hits) actually triggers them more often; Warm-blooded and Undead are always-on / night passives that ignore proc chance.

Synergy counts transplanted non-native organs; sources and transplant rules are in Seven Genomes and Installation & Care. For a temporary boost across a full build, check the Three Breakthrough Modes under Genotypes · Potions.
